tasks.title: The test gate has room for this phase: at least 30 s of GUT time freed without weakening any test
tasks.description: The verification harness kills the gate at about 300 s wall clock and Phase 4 closed at GUT time 256.8 s plus import and boot. Before any Phase 5 test lands, measure per-file GUT time, record the slowest files in tests/README.md (new 'Gate time' heading), add scripts/gate-time.sh, and cut at least 30 s of GUT time using only the means plan section 2.2 allows: the 8x clock for files that await real physics at 1x, computing a hand-ticked simulation that several tests replay identically once in before_all (tests/integration/test_fighter_squad.gd is the heaviest, ~65 s), and dropping per-tick bookkeeping no assertion reads. Never lower a tick count, duration, sample count or start grid an assertion depends on. If 30 s cannot be found that way, stop with Result: ESCALATE and the measurements.
tasks.acceptanceCriteria: GUT time at least 30 s below the measured 'before' on the same machine; test count unchanged; every test green; scripts/check-test-leaks.sh prints LEAK CHECK PASS; scripts/gate-time.sh prints the 15 slowest test files; tests/README.md has the Gate time section with the before/after numbers.
